Stands as a disagreement between reports, already flagged in the record (died is status: debated). Ibn Ishaq counts him among the Weepers at Tabuk in 9 AH ({cite:ibn-hisham-saqqa 4/161}); the death at Uhud in 3 AH is al-Mustaghfiri's report, which Ibn Hajar, who quotes it, calls a likely confusion with Amr ibn al-Jamuh or Umayr ibn al-Humam (al-Isaba p. 1096, read in the harvest text). Making the two agree means removing the death date, which is the founder's decision: proposed removal of died 0625 / AH 0003 from data/person/amr-ibn-humam-ibn-al-jamuh.yaml, or keep it as a recorded disagreement.

Nothing to correct the field to: proposed removal of died 624 from data/person/salim-ibn-umayr.yaml (founder's decision).

Stands as a disagreement between sources. The event and al-Aghlab's record follow al-Baladhuri, who has al-Aghlab appointed by Musa al-Hadi and Harish killed in the pursuit after his fall ({cite:futuh-buldan-maarif-1407 p. 326-327}), hence 785/786; Harish's died 767 (150 AH) was written by the date-enrichment pass from al-Bayan al-Mughrib, which is not among his record's sources. No source cited by either record settles which year is right, and the event's own prose already asks for a second source; for the founder: read al-Bayan al-Mughrib on the page, then align the event, person/al-aghab-ibn-salim and person/harish-al-tunisi on one year.
